incident_evidence_requirements: A first-person report of a specific occurrence
A Velora charger model or serial identifier
An observable fire, flame, smoke, heat, or damage outcome
A mapped customer contact for investigation follow-up

accepted_incident_ticket.title: Charger fire intake INC-VRC-0028
accepted_incident_ticket.article_body: Program VRC-C2-26 incident intake. Source post: post_fire_vrc_0028 by @maya_pedals. Customer: Maya Ortiz at maya.ortiz@cyclemail.example. Product: Velora VoltRide C2 charger, model VRC-C2, serial VRC2-26-441908. Occurrence: 2026-09-07 at approximately 02:10 in a detached garage. Reported evidence: flame at the charger cable exit, scorched workbench, smoke alarm activation, and fire department incident FD-26-7714. The customer reports using the charger once after the event. Engagement at review: zero likes, retweets, replies, and views. Investigation follow-up required.

creation_rule: Create one ticket only if all incident evidence requirements match and no existing Zammad ticket contains the duplicate key.
